raw.title: Second Vienna Award
raw.description: 1940 territorial settlement between the kingdoms of Romania and Hungary
raw.extract: The Second Vienna Award was the second of two territorial disputes that were arbitrated by Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy. On 30 August 1940, they assigned the territory of Northern Transylvania, including all of Maramureș and part of Crișana, from the Kingdom of Romania to the Kingdom of Hungary.
